leaveTypes.title: Leave Types
leaveTypes.description: Define the categories of leave your company offers (Annual, Sick, Unpaid, etc.) and whether each draws from a yearly balance.

leaveBalances.title: Leave Balances
leaveBalances.description: Set or correct how many days of each balance-tracked leave type an employee has for a given year.
leaveBalances.selectEmployeePrompt: Select an employee to view their balances.

performanceCycles.title: Performance Cycles
performanceCycles.description: Define review periods (e.g. "Q1 2026") that employee evaluations are grouped under.

performanceCriteria.title: Performance Criteria
performanceCriteria.description: Define the rating dimensions (e.g. "Communication", "Technical Skills") used across every evaluation.

performanceEvaluations.title: Performance Evaluations
performanceEvaluations.empty: No evaluations yet for this cycle.
performanceEvaluations.selectCyclePrompt: Select a cycle to see its evaluations.
